meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统管多个开发工作区,交接任务给其他 AI 助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在多个开发工作区里同时跑 AI 助手,常需要任务交接。
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple dev worktrees and hand off tasks between AI assistants.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use several AI assistants across dev worktrees and often pass work between them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 orca CLI 操作 Orca 管理的 worktree、文件夹上下文、终端、仓库、自动化、artifacts、worktree 评论及内嵌浏览器；执行前先获取该版本的完整指南并用 status 确认状态。
howto.when: 当用户提到“$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”等关键词，或要求交接任务（handoff）、控制 Orca 内嵌浏览器时触发。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 查一下当前 worktree 列表
say.note: 会先加载完整指南再执行。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 读取 Orca 终端的最新输出
say.note: 它会通过 JSON 接口获取终端内容。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 把当前工作交给另一个 agent
say.note: 会执行完整的 worktree 交接。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the orca CLI to manage Orca worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, worktree comments, and the embedded browser. It first fetches the version-matched guide and checks status before running commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", or asks for handoff, or controlling the browser embedded in Orca.

say_en.note: It loads the full guide first, then runs the command.

say_en.text: Read latest output from the Orca terminal with orca-cli
say_en.note: It uses the JSON API to fetch terminal output.

say_en.text: Hand off the current work to another agent with orca-cli
say_en.note: It performs a full handover in the worktree.
